2. Configura l'`AnimationTree`:
   - Imposta **Anim Player** assegnandogli il nodo `AnimationPlayer`.

func _run_tests() -> void:
	var main := await instantiate_main_scene()
	if not check("main", main != null, "La scena principale deve caricarsi senza errori"):
		return
	var player := find_by_name(main, "Player") as CharacterBody2D
	if not check("player", player != null, "Il nodo Player deve essere presente"):
		return
	var tree := find_by_name(player, "AnimationTree") as AnimationTree
	if not check("tree", tree != null, "Player deve contenere un nodo AnimationTree"):
		return
	check("tree_active", tree.active, "L'AnimationTree deve essere attivo (active = true)")
	var playback: AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback = tree.get("parameters/playback")
	if not check("playback", playback != null, "L'AnimationTree deve avere una root StateMachine con playback accessibile"):
		return
	await wait_physics_frames(5)
	check("idle", playback.get_current_node() == &"idle", "Da fermo la macchina a stati dell'animazione deve trovarsi nello stato 'idle'")
	await hold_action("move_right", 15)
	check("run", playback.get_current_node() == &"run", "Muovendosi con move_right lo stato dell'animazione deve diventare 'run'")
	await wait_physics_frames(10)
	await tap_action("attack")
	await wait_physics_frames(3)
	check("attack", playback.get_current_node() == &"attack", "Premendo attack lo stato dell'animazione deve diventare 'attack'")

      "percorso": "player/player.gd",
      "contenuto": "extends CharacterBody2D

@export var speed: float = 200.0
@export var jump_velocity: float = -400.0

var gravity: float = 980.0
var is_attacking: bool = false

@onready var animated_sprite: AnimatedSprite2D = $AnimatedSprite2D
@onready var animation_player: AnimationPlayer = $AnimationPlayer
@onready var animation_tree: AnimationTree = $AnimationTree

var playback: AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback


func _ready() -> void:
	if animation_player:
		animation_player.animation_finished.connect(_on_animation_finished)
	if animation_tree:
		playback = animation_tree["parameters/playback"]


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y += gravity * delta

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = jump_velocity

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("attack") and not is_attacking:
		is_attacking = true
		velocity.x = 0.0
		if playback:
			playback.travel("attack")

	if not is_attacking:
		var direction := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
		if direction != 0.0:
			velocity.x = direction * speed
			if animated_sprite:
				animated_sprite.flip_h = direction < 0.0
			if playback:
				playback.travel("run")
		else:
			velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0.0, speed)
			if playback:
				playback.travel("idle")

	move_and_slide()


func _on_animation_finished(anim_name: StringName) -> void:
	if anim_name == &"attack":
		is_attacking = false

@export var speed: float = 200.0
@export var jump_velocity: float = -400.0

var gravity: float = 980.0
var is_attacking: bool = false

@onready var animated_sprite: AnimatedSprite2D = $AnimatedSprite2D
@onready var animation_player: AnimationPlayer = $AnimationPlayer
@onready var animation_tree: AnimationTree = $AnimationTree

var playback: AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback


func _ready() -> void:
	if animation_player:
		animation_player.animation_finished.connect(_on_animation_finished)
	if animation_tree:
		playback = animation_tree["parameters/playback"]


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y += gravity * delta

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = jump_velocity

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("attack") and not is_attacking:
		is_attacking = true
		velocity.x = 0.0
		if playback:
			playback.travel("attack")

	if not is_attacking:
		var direction := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
		if direction != 0.0:
			velocity.x = direction * speed
			if animated_sprite:
				animated_sprite.flip_h = direction < 0.0
		else:
			velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0.0, speed)

		var blend: float = absf(velocity.x) / speed
		animation_tree["parameters/move_blend/blend_position"] = blend

	move_and_slide()


func _on_animation_finished(anim_name: StringName) -> void:
	if anim_name == &"attack":
		is_attacking = false
